# Authored analysis fixtures

All source and annotations in this directory are original Glyphibe fixtures,
licensed under the repository's MPL-2.0 license. They are static analysis inputs,
not programs that Glyphibe executes.

Analyze each language directory separately. The manually reviewed
`calls.expected.json` files contain 47 distinct caller/callee pairs in total.
Dynamic callback targets are intentionally absent. Matching this small dataset
does not establish real-world accuracy.
